summary: Hub Cyber Security Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 1-for-20 reverse share split, effective June 5, 2026, to increase the per-share trading price and maintain Nasdaq minimum bid price compliance. No fractional shares will be issued; instead fractional shares are rounded down. The split reduces outstanding shares from 66,603,152 to approximately 3,330,157, not altering percentage ownership except for fractional share adjustments. Outstanding equity rights will be adjusted accordingly. This is a routine capital structure change, not a special situation event.
